items.t: 20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie, Burnaby at a median of $1,850,250 (middle half $1,673,750 to $2,013,750). A typical house in Sperling-Duthie, Burnaby spent 35 days on the market and closed at 94.5% of the asking price.
